sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the bail application, the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.24 of 2021 at Police Station-Fariha, District-Firozabad under Sections 177, 182, 420, 193 IPC.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 02.09.2021.

The following arguments made by Shri Ajay Kumar Dwivedi, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned A.G.A.-I for the State from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1).

The applicant did not lodge any F.I.R.
(2).
The applicant is a law abiding citizen who surrendered as and when he was advised to do so.
(3). The applicant was implicated only to deflect attention from deficient police investigations.
(4). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
(5). The applicant is not a flight risk.

The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court Satish Khan vs State Of U.P. on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57959448/

sentences.text: There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Satish Khan be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
